title: Above that limit, they collapse into black holes.
purpose: Explain the fate of too-massive neutron stars.
narration: Neutron stars are incredibly dense. If they exceed a certain mass limit, they cannot support themselves and collapse into a black hole. That limit is called the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff limit.
